title: The Dead Man Who Fooled Hitler

scenes.headline: DEAD MAN'S MISSION
scenes.text: This is the dead man who fooled Hitler.

scenes.headline: DEAD MAN'S MISSION
scenes.text: He never fired a shot. Yet he helped the Allies take Sicily.
Nineteen forty-three. The Allies want to invade Sicily. It is the obvious target.

scenes.headline: A FAKE SECRET
scenes.text: So British intelligence decides to hand the Germans a fake secret.

scenes.headline: MAJOR MARTIN
scenes.text: They take a dead man and give him a new life: Major William Martin.

scenes.headline: MAJOR MARTIN
scenes.text: Love letters. Theatre tickets. And a briefcase of fake secret letters.

scenes.headline: OFF SPAIN
scenes.text: A submarine releases him off the coast of Spain.

scenes.headline: GREECE?
scenes.text: The papers reach the Germans. They say the real target is Greece and Sardinia.

scenes.headline: WRONG PLACE
scenes.text: Hitler sends reinforcements to the wrong places.

scenes.headline: SICILY
scenes.text: In July, the Allies land in Sicily.

scenes.headline: NEVER EXISTED
scenes.text: And Major Martin? He never existed. Would you have believed him?
